review_method: Read-only inspection; no tests or experiments run by reviewer
supported_methods: paired and unpaired SE and empirical covariance
signed item-by-model axes and four-cell sampling
full-family Holm before extracting microaccuracy-ranked adjacencies
strongest_result: 128-item observed-gap plans targeting 80% achieved 49.3–78.6% benchmark-level median heldout empirical-IID detection; pilot-curve error was 10.0–25.4 percentage points versus 1.9–4.4 for the heldout-fitted normal reference.
interpretation: The practical result narrowly warns against noisy-gap planning; it does not establish a reliable prespecified-effect budget estimator. fixed_target_plans.csv.gz records fixed-effect budget estimates and heldout-variance references, not a separate empirical power validation of that design.
limitations_to_keep_visible: selected related historical models, not current frontier coverage
missing original evaluation revisions and document IDs
MMLU alignment inherited from exporter; non-MMLU ordering author-checked
conditional empirical resampling, not new questions or future-subject guarantees
qualified data-license evidence, not blanket MIT relicensing
